content.text: skills/lifecycle이 Intake와 Work Unit checkpoint에 공통으로 사용하는 deterministic handoff command와 machine-readable receipt contract를 소유해야 한다.
Intake checkpoint는 package identity와 artifactType을 확인하고 Intake manager의 full validation이 성공하며 lifecycle status가 ready일 때만 허용해야 한다.

Work Unit checkpoint는 package identity와 artifactType을 확인하고 Work Unit manager의 full validation이 성공하며 lifecycle status가 ready이고 canonical intake-basis-ref가 먼저 checkpoint된 동일 ready Intake를 가리킬 때만 허용해야 한다.
각 checkpoint는 exact package path, full validation result, exact commit message를 Human에게 제시한 뒤 해당 단계의 explicit approval input이 있을 때만 Git mutation을 수행해야 한다.
Checkpoint는 승인된 canonical package의 manager-owned exact file set만 stage하고 commit해야 하며, unrelated staged 또는 unstaged 변경을 commit에 포함하거나 폐기하거나 덮어쓰지 않아야 한다.

성공 receipt는 schema version, artifact type과 id, canonical package path, validation mode와 결과, target branch, before와 after commit, exact commit message, Human decision, operation ledger, success state를 포함해야 하며 refusal도 machine-readable error와 mutation-free operation evidence를 반환해야 한다.
두 번째 Work Unit checkpoint의 after commit을 worktree.py prepare의 base로 사용해야 하며, 생성된 work-unit/<work-unit-id> branch와 canonical linked worktree에서 ready Intake와 ready Work Unit package가 모두 검증 가능해야 한다.
Handoff는 artifact 복사본, 외부 staging directory, 임시 backup을 생성하지 않아야 하며, Intake와 Work Unit manager의 JSON ownership 및 work-unit-execution의 branch/worktree ownership을 변경하지 않아야 한다.
Active lifecycle, intake, work-unit-planner, work-unit-execution 문서와 focused tests는 두 checkpoint의 순서, 승인 경계, failure atomicity, exact-path isolation, receipt, worktree base handoff를 일관되게 검증해야 한다.
Checkpoint는 repository root와 expected artifact root에 package path를 고정하고 package 내부 symlink를 거부하며, validation과 staging 사이의 변경 또는 directory swap을 staged content 검증으로 탐지하여 commit 전에 거부해야 한다.

items: Checkpoint 대상 branch는 Human이 결정한 main이다.
Artifact managers remain the sole JSON construction and serialization owners.
Work Unit planning does not create branch or linked worktree side effects.
Checkpoint failure before commit must leave HEAD unchanged and restore or preserve pre-existing index and working-tree state.
The command must not use shell interpolation for Git arguments.

criteria: A ready Intake checkpoint on main succeeds only with approved input, commits exactly the canonical Intake package, and returns a success receipt whose afterCommit equals main HEAD.
A ready Work Unit checkpoint succeeds only after its referenced ready Intake is already an ancestor of main and commits exactly the canonical Work Unit package as a separate second commit.

Draft, invalid, wrong-type, wrong-id, wrong-root, wrong-branch, missing-approval, mismatched-basis, symlink, content-race, unrelated-staged-collision, and Git failure cases return nonzero refusal JSON without an unauthorized commit.
Unrelated unstaged files are neither committed, overwritten, removed, nor backed up; unrelated staged state is preserved by refusing before mutation.
An exact replay after a successful commit returns already-checkpointed with the existing commit and creates no additional commit.
Read-only inspection reconstructs the exact Work Unit checkpoint commit from Git and package content without Human approval or mutation.
After the second checkpoint, worktree.py prepare with the inspected afterCommit creates work-unit/<work-unit-id> whose linked worktree contains and fully validates both packages.
Focused tests cover both success phases, exact replay recovery, read-only inspection, failure cleanup, staged-path isolation, and an adversarial validation-to-stage swap.
The bundled Plugin Creator validator succeeds for the modified plugin.
Skill documentation names the two approval prompts, exact path and message disclosure, inspection or receipt handoff, and the separation from Work Unit integration or cleanup.

content.text: Commit이 성공한 뒤 caller가 receipt를 받기 전에 중단된 경우, 동일 artifact state와 동일 approved commit message로 재실행하면 추가 commit 없이 already-checkpointed success receipt를 반환하여 복구할 수 있어야 한다.

Fresh execution session은 hidden chat이나 uncommitted receipt 없이 lifecycle handoff command의 read-only inspection으로 ready Work Unit package의 exact checkpoint commit을 재구성하고, 그 commit을 worktree.py prepare base로 사용해야 한다.

Work Unit 초기 실행 admission은 package resolve, full validation, lifecycle status ready, readiness flags, reviewedAt, required sections와 content kinds, unresolved blocker 부재, canonical execution context, ready Intake basis를 모두 확인해야 한다. 하나라도 실패하면 worktree 준비, execution-init, attempt-start, scoped mutation 전에 machine-readable refusal을 반환하고 repository와 Work Unit execution state를 변경하지 않아야 한다.

criteria: A missing, ambiguous, structurally invalid, semantically incomplete, non-ready, blocker-bearing, execution-context-invalid, or Intake-basis-invalid Work Unit is refused before worktree preparation, execution-init, attempt-start, or scoped mutation, with no repository or execution-state mutation.

Direct invocation of the Git worktree boundary cannot create or reuse an execution worktree unless the canonical Work Unit package passes full validation and ready admission for the same id, repository, base, branch, and path.
A full-valid ready Work Unit with an explicit execution request starts without a repeated approval or settled-decision question.

After attempt-start, each externally visible execution transition is durably recorded so a fresh Codex session can reconstruct the current revision, attempt, invocation chain, completed steps, pending step, and last verified repository head.
A simulated process or session interruption resumes the same working attempt from its last durable checkpoint without repeating an already completed non-idempotent side effect.
Transient failures follow a recorded bounded retry policy and retryable mutations use idempotency identity or deterministic receipts.

An unrecoverable failure or exhausted retry policy records exact evidence and an unresolved blocking item before transition to blocked; the executor must not silently leave an active working attempt abandoned.

After a blocked active attempt has evidence that its blocker is resolved, public manager commands can restore and resume the same revision and attempt without discarding history or creating an unapproved rework revision.
Only completed work with passing verification and AI review reaches review.

Focused manager, contract, and temporary-repository tests cover admission refusal, direct prepare bypass refusal, interruption recovery, idempotent replay, transient retry, blocked recovery, and explicit blocked outcomes.

content.text: Admission을 통과해 attempt가 시작된 Work Unit은 확정된 범위와 결정을 다시 묻지 않고 durable execution progress를 canonical execution state에 checkpoint해야 한다. 프로세스나 세션 중단과 transient failure 뒤에는 마지막 완료 checkpoint에서 자동 resume하고 retryable mutation은 idempotent하게 재실행하며, 검증 완료 후 review 또는 복구 불가능 근거와 unresolved blocking item을 가진 blocked에 도달할 때까지 자동 실행 책임을 유지해야 한다.

기존 canonical package의 일부 파일만 parent commit과 달라진 re-checkpoint는 변경된 canonical subset만 commit diff에 포함하되 checkpoint commit의 전체 package tree file set과 각 canonical file hash가 owning manager의 validated snapshot과 일치할 때 성공해야 한다.

criteria: A first checkpoint of a newly created canonical package still commits its complete canonical file set.

A re-checkpoint after modifying only a subset of an existing package commits exactly that changed canonical subset and succeeds only when the checkpoint commit tree contains the complete validated canonical package file set with matching hashes.
An exact replay of the re-checkpoint returns already-checkpointed without an additional commit.
Read-only inspect resolves and validates the latest partial re-checkpoint commit from the complete package tree rather than requiring every canonical path in that commit's diff.
Focused regression tests pass and existing unrelated staged-state, symlink, race, wrong-root, and failure-cleanup behavior remains unchanged.
